criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1, 3, 7 (28 counted) and 9 pass at feed size. 6 primitive cream boxes with no pool, contact or cast and the stake line missing; 2 a flat outline with an unmodelled black channel; 4 a flat slab with a white clip for flagging; 5 black stakes, an unseated stringline, repeated sprites, no seam lights; 8's gooseneck crosses 'questions'.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one key, one accent, three named devices with a describable spine. 2 sits outside the vocabulary and 6 breaks the 5 to 6 camera move.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and round 1's join is repaired. Legs rest on the Tribune where primaries exist, 'stops at the line' leans on 'circumventing', the 109 invites a cheap-deal reading, and frame 6's cite line carries c12 and c19 unused.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where, what and when are delivered. The tax break carries no size or term and no frame says the notice gives none.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe and 2 pays. The chronology zig-zags at 4, 8 steps back after the hearing, 9 restates 7.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain and specific with a Texan register. Attribution repeats across 5 and 6 and 9's dek is a bare address line. House rules hold.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No topic repeat. No. 61's city limit sign, stakes on 62 and 69, and 62's abatement beside its own power recur; lastLight again.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild 6 as frame 5's flagged line of 20 or more stakes running to a plant seated in its own pool, and 2 as a square of flagged lath and stringline on a modelled flat with a real road and riprap edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: cream boxes on the horizon with no pool, contact or cast, the stake line missing
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: 20 or more stakes from the lower left converging on the unit, a ground pool with contact and a long cast, galvanized and painted steel

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: flat outline, unmodelled black channel, nothing of known size
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: the square as flagged lath and stringline on a modelled flat, the kit road and riprap casting, a truck for scale

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: black stakes, plastic flagging, unseated stringline, repeated sprites, no seam lights
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: weathered pine with cloth flagging, stringline on each stake top, sodium lights on the left seam

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: flat slab with a white clip for flagging
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: pine grain, wet clay foot, split end, limp cloth flagging draped with its own shadow

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: gooseneck crosses 'questions', a rod behind the last two dek lines
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: camera down so the mic head sits 60 px under the dek, the dais mic out of the type column
